pipeline.constraint: positive-only prompt; background anchored by first frame; i2v = motion + camera only

character_spec_en: 24-year-old East Asian woman, oval face, delicate facial features, slender naturally toned build, graceful upright posture, about 168cm, healthy weight. Clean-girl makeup (25-35 words, five slots): dewy natural skin with visible pores and faint peach fuzz, soft peach blush on the apples of her cheeks, sheer glossy nude-pink lips, natural fluffy brows brushed upward, minimal eye makeup with thin brown eyeliner and curled lashes; light freckles across the nose, faint under-eye texture (unfiltered, >=2 imperfections). Dark-brown eyes with moist light reflection. Long silky black hair middle-parted with loose glossy strands. Jewelry max 2 pieces: small gold hoop earrings + delicate gold pendant necklace at collarbone. Camera anchor: Fujifilm X100V look, 50mm f/2.8, light film grain.

bedroom_primary.background_en: A cozy sunlit bedroom. A neatly made bed with white linen and one rumpled corner sits near a large window; sheer pale-beige curtains diffuse the morning light. A potted monstera stands in the corner softly blurred, a wooden nightstand holds a folded blanket, soft cream wall.
bedroom_primary.light_en: Soft natural window light from camera left, warm morning tone, low contrast, gentle rim light on the figure.
bedroom_primary.risks: bed/mirror straight lines at frame edge; mirror reflection blurred

cafe_alternate.background_en: A cozy café interior. A wooden table with a ceramic coffee cup anchors the foreground; blurred shelves of cups, a chalkboard menu, and static warm pendant lights recede behind. A leafy potted plant sits by a foggy window.
cafe_alternate.light_en: Warm mixed light: soft window daylight plus low pendant lamp glow, low contrast, warm tone.
cafe_alternate.risks: table lines foreground-blurred; pendant static; chalkboard text illegible

street_cautious.background_en: A city sidewalk beside a boutique café storefront. Blurred pedestrians and slow-moving traffic form a soft background; a green planter box and a striped awning anchor the foreground, a brick wall and a distant crosswalk recede behind.
street_cautious.light_en: Soft overcast daylight, low saturation, flat even lighting, no harsh shadows.
street_cautious.props_limit: people/cars always blurred, no counts, signage illegible
street_cautious.risks: traffic/pedestrians = top collapse source; only with locked camera

background_rules_i2v: never rewrite background in i2v; one consistency sentence only
Blurred ... forms the background + out of focus
soft organic materials over hard geometry
reflection blurred / foggy glass for mirrors
positive tail: background stays stable and consistent, no morphing, no flickering textures
face_budget_rule: 15s face budget = one natural blink + one smile gradation (relaxed confident -> bright genuine, eyes slightly crinkled); full-body framing face = atmosphere level, skin/makeup words render at first frame only

妆容/饰品/发型与首帧一致
